facts: Identity check at reconciliation (v5 D9): PDF 88-0233 = not established: sources conflict. The one source that shows the card's own pattern labels it (Zr6.86Mg0.14)O11.28N1.72, a zirconium oxynitride; one paper attaches the number to fcc Ru metal; only the paper under review calls it RuO2. No source establishes it as rutile RuO2; rutile-type (P4_2/mnm): unresolved.
